correctness.rationale: The proof partitions arbitrary nonlinear codes by all but one input column; any two last columns at binary distance 1 or 2 give augmented matrices at Hamming distance 2 and confusable single-substitution balls, so each fiber ≤A_2(ℓ,3). A maximum length-ℓ distance-3 parity-row seed supplies that many matrices per prefix, while a length edit identifies its row and all other rows reconstruct it; one substitution is located by odd column parity and corrected through unique row-parity decoding. This handles no edit, parity-row edit, arbitrary nonlinear seeds and n>ℓ.
residual_risks: Only one total output-row edit; full multiedit models not covered.
